label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 present receipt is concurrent actualization, checked (inference)
rule: Unfold passionReceipt: receipt includes a giver at the moment; the present-tense reading then says a giver exists at every moment of presence
meaning: Closed result with no premises, quantified over every history, giving relation and reception predicate. On the passion sense, correlativity is the second conjunct of the definition, and the present-tense reading of reception, after its first conjunct (the reception hypothesis itself), says that at every moment at which a received-esse thing is present something gives it being: weak concurrent actualization 40a97664, in both directions. It shows that on this sense the present-tense reading is 40a97664 under another name. It establishes nothing about reality.
